sonnet.problem: The joke comparison doesn't hold together. A three-day journey is long, but the line says you'd pass the oven a hundred times 'before the timer dings', which suggests a short stretch of time. It also leans on the cookie planet's size and an oven timer, so it mixes images and a stranger would say 'huh?'.
sonnet.rule: The everyday comparison must have the same action. One image only. Never blend the comparison with the Bible setting. It clicks instantly for any adult, with no explaining. If a stranger would say "huh?", rewrite it.
